description:
• Brand introduction: 

The decision to name the brand Well Sayed, and the first product Alpha Pharaoh was driven by a desire to pay tribute to the founder's Egyptian heritage while incorporating the strength and power of ancient pharaohs into the brand. However, Well Sayed is much more than just a name. It embodies a belief system that is centered on being dependable, consistent, and empowering.

At Well Sayed, we believe in delivering a product that works every time, ensuring that each and every serving is of the highest quality. We treat customers with respect and honesty, and our mission is to empower them to achieve their fitness goals. Furthermore, we believe that everyone has the potential to be an alpha, strong, powerful, and in control of their own destiny. Our products not only provide a physical boost for workouts, but also the foundation to dominate in all aspects of life with a healthy body and mind.

If you're ready to take charge of your fitness journey and become an alpha, give Alpha Pharaoh a try. They are confident that you won't be disappointed, as their commitment to excellence is reflected in every aspect of their brand.


• Product description: 

Introducing Alpha Pharaoh, the ultimate supplement for athletes who want to take their training to the next level. With its carefully crafted blend of 13 all-natural ingredients, Alpha Pharaoh provides unparalleled muscle-building and performance-enhancing benefits to help you achieve your fitness goals.

Our formula contains key ingredients such as Beta Alanine, which helps to prevent muscle fatigue and soreness during intense workouts, and Tart Cherry extract, which has been shown to accelerate muscle recovery time. Additionally, our supplement is packed with caffeine anhydrous to give you an extra boost of energy and focus, allowing you to power through your toughest training sessions with ease.

At Well Sayed, we believe in delivering a product that consistently performs at the highest level, ensuring that every serving is of the utmost quality. We treat our customers with respect and honesty, and our mission is to empower you to achieve your fitness goals and become an alpha - strong, powerful, and in control of your own destiny.

If you're ready to take charge of your fitness journey and experience the full benefits of your hard work and dedication, try Alpha Pharaoh today. With its powerful blend of all-natural ingredients, Alpha Pharaoh is the perfect supplement to help you build muscle, increase performance, and dominate in all aspects of your life.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

Well Sayed Pre-Workout is a natural, effective blend of 13 carefully selected ingredients, including essential recovery components.

The formula is free of unnecessary additives, ensuring fast and tangible results without any adverse side effects.

Alpha Pharaoh Pre-Workout tastes great, making it the perfect choice for those who want to improve their health without sacrificing taste.

Includes Tart Cherry Extract which lessens pain and accelerates strength recovery after exercise and decreases blood markers of inflammation/oxidative stress. These improvements occur in both strength and endurance exercise. Alpha Pharaoh is  only pre-workout that offers Cherry Tart in the market.

We draw inspiration from the wisdom of ancient Egyptian heritage, reflecting a commitment to holistic nourishment for both the body and mind.

Our core values emphasizes a commitment to excellence, dependability, and fairness, ensuring that customers receive the best possible experience with our brand.

 

Commissions: You will earn a commission for each qualified sale generated through your unique affiliate link. Commissions are based on the final purchase amount after discounts and excluding taxes, shipping, and returns.

Affiliate Links: You will be provided with unique affiliate tracking links and banners for promotional use. These links are essential for accurate commission tracking and reporting.

Cookie Duration: Cookies are set to a 365-day tracking period. If a customer makes a purchase within this period after clicking your affiliate link, you will receive the commission.

Payouts: Commissions will be paid on a regular monthly basis as outlined in the affiliate program documentation. Payouts are subject to a minimum threshold, as determined by Well Sayed Labs.

Payment Method: Payments will be made through the chosen payment method during the application process. You are responsible for providing accurate payment information.

Tracking and Reporting: You will have access to a dashboard with real-time tracking and reporting of clicks, conversions, and commissions generated through your affiliate links.

Welcome to Well Sayed Labs! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: sharif@wellsayedlabs.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to sharif@wellsayedlabs.com for support.
